name: Palkova
ingredients: A small drop of lemon juice (optional, for texture)
instructions: 1. Pour the milk into a wide, heavy-bottomed pan or kadai.
2. Bring the milk to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring continuously to prevent burning.
3. Reduce heat to low once it begins to thicken, scraping down the sides of the pan constantly.
4. Continue to cook and stir until the milk reduces to about one-fourth of its original volume and turns a pale cream color.
5. Add the sugar and continue stirring as the mixture thickens further into a granular mass.
7. Once the mixture starts to leave the sides of the pan and achieves a soft, fudge-like texture, remove from heat and let it cool.
description: Palkova, particularly the famous version from Srivilliputhur in Tamil Nadu, is a cherished dairy delicacy. It holds deep cultural significance as a celebratory sweet offered in temples and served during weddings and festivals, known for its rich, caramelized milk flavor.
